# Buoy

Buoy is the AI employee for independent businesses in North County San Diego
(Oceanside, Carlsbad, Vista, San Marcos, Encinitas). One monthly retainer
covers ten systems most small businesses leak money through. Founded 2026.
Website: https://buoydesk.com

## What Buoy does

Ten named service areas, audited and installed fastest-payoff first:

- After Hours: calls and texts answered after hours, so no lead goes to voicemail.
- Lean Stack: kill software bloat; keep only the tools that earn their keep.
- Full Picture: every customer and job in one place.
- AI Crew: an AI-native team around the business.
- Get Found: website and social presence tuned for search and AI answers (SEO + GEO).
- Regulars: repeat business on autopilot.
- Five Stars: a review engine that brings in steady five-star reviews.
- Quote Rescue: follow-up on dead quotes.
- Full Book: no-show defense to keep the schedule full.
- Call Intel: every call scored, callbacks flagged.

## Pricing

- Founding 10: $595/month, locked for 12 months. Three-month commitment, then month-to-month.
- Future standard price: $1,250/month.
- Opportunity audit: $250, credited toward month one (presented as a $750 value).
- Guarantee: 2x your fees back in measurable recovered revenue within 90 days, or month three is free.
- Anchor: a part-time office manager costs $2,500+/month.

## Who it's for

Independent auto repair shops, HVAC/plumbing contractors, dental practices,
and other North County service businesses losing revenue to missed calls,
dead quotes, no-shows, and thin reviews. Typical finding: ~27% of inbound
calls go unanswered, at roughly $1,200 in lost revenue per missed call.
